risks.proof: flash test report or IV curve measurement under standard test conditions.
risks.if_unproven: as not working or degraded output

risks.risk: The label in photo 1 may not belong to the exact panel shown in photo 0.
risks.proof: photo showing the label physically fixed to that same module, or a matching serial number.

risks.risk: Junction box, frame, and output cable condition are not visible.
risks.proof: close-up photos of the junction box, frame corners, and cable/connector.

proof_requests: Photo showing the SUNPOWER label attached to the exact panel in photo 0.
Close-up of the junction box and output cable/connector.
Flash test report or multimeter Voc/Isc reading under sunlight.
response.reason: The model and 300 W rating are read from the label in photo 1, and the 72-cell layout is visible in photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested used panel.
